title: Wellness Membership Payment, Refund and Adjustment Policy
content:
Wellness Membership dues are paid by automatic draft from a card or a bank account.

## 1. Method of payment

Dues are drafted automatically by card or bank account where the tier requires automatic draft. HSA and FSA cards are not accepted for dues while the tier is not HSA or FSA eligible.

## 2. Failed drafts

A failed draft is retried 3 calendar days later. The figure is 3 calendar days on every tier.

## 3. Cooling-off refund

A member who cancels no later than 3 business days after the sign-up date is refunded every payment in full, counting business days Monday to Friday excluding federal holidays, the sign-up date itself being day zero. The cooling-off period is 3 business days on every tier.

- The sign-up date is the date recorded on that membership in the company's records, and the cancellation and the refund concern that same membership.
- The last day of the period counts: a cancellation on business day 3 is within it.

## 4. Other cancellations

Dues already billed for the final period are not refunded on any other cancellation while the tier does not provide a prorated refund of the final period.

## 5. Adjustments

An adjustment reduces a billed charge without payment. Adjustments exist only for a waived enrollment, freeze, late or early-termination fee and for a billing error.

## Business-day boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Sign-up (day zero) | Federal holiday in the period | Business days 1, 2, 3 | Cancellation on | Within the cooling-off period |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monday | none | Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday | Thursday | Yes |
| Monday | none | Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday | Friday | No, business day 4 |
| Thursday | none | Friday, Monday, Tuesday | Tuesday | Yes |
| Thursday | none | Friday, Monday, Tuesday | Wednesday | No, business day 4 |
| Friday | the following Monday | Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday | Thursday | Yes |

Saturdays, Sundays and federal holidays are not business days and are skipped in the count.

## Adjustment reasons at a glance

| Reason | Adjustment available |
|---|---|
| Enrollment fee waived | Yes |
| Freeze fee waived | Yes |
| Late fee waived | Yes |
| Early-termination fee waived | Yes |
| Billing error | Yes |
